blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.
blocks.zh: 视频出漆是一个重要的问题,然而现有的研究主要侧重于短片片段,而长片出漆则基本上未得到充分探讨. 将视频扩展至长视频构成重大挑战。 一个自然的解决方案是迭代出画,即逐块生成视频,但这提出了两个主要问题:生成不稳定性,甚至因相通不一致和误差积累而导致的失败,以及语义漂移在长的时间线上. 在本文中,我们提出LongSCOP,简称为"语义一致"(Semantical Conference)的长相视频出镜. 首先,我们引入了一种培训配方,其中包含平稳而稳定的长视距生成的三个组成部分:自我强制培训、潜在校正和未来参考。 除了一代人的稳定之外,我们认识到长相视频丰富的时间背景为保持语义一致性提供了宝贵的参考。 因此,我们开发了一个基于VLM的代理,自动从整个视频中选择信息最丰富的参考框架,以在长视一代中保持一致的主题,场景和背景. 我们还建造了由62K个录像片段组成的高质量培训数据集。 为了促进对这一未得到充分探讨的问题的研究,我们采用了LVO-Bench,这是由人类专家制定的基准,用于评估长相稳定性和语义一致性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在生成稳定性和语义一致性方面都超过了现有方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long video out-painting is an important yet underexplored problem.
Video out-painting aims to expand the spatial field of view of a video beyond its originally observed boundaries [ 38 ] , and has many applications [ 48 , 8 ] .
Benefiting from the rapid progress of video generation models [ 27 , 37 ] , recent video out-painting methods have achieved encouraging results in synthesizing visually realistic and temporally smooth content [ 50 , 7 ] .
Meanwhile, extending out-painting from short clips ( e.g. , a few seconds) to substantially longer videos ( e.g. , 20 seconds or more) is increasingly important in real-world usage.
Such long-form content has become a dominant format on modern video platforms [ 11 ] , and it usually contains richer narratives and more dynamic scene transitions compared to short clips; thus, it is more valuable for practical applications [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh:
长时间的视频外绘是一个重要的但探索不足的问题.
视频出画旨在将视频的取景空间范围扩大到最初观察到的边界外[38],并有许多应用[48,8].
从视频生成模式的快速进步[27,37]中获益,近期的视频出画方法在将视觉现实和时间平滑的内容合成[50,7]方面取得了令人鼓舞的成果.
同时,从短片(如:几秒钟)到大幅延长的视频(如:20秒或更长时间)的外绘在现实世界的使用中越来越重要.
这种长式内容已经成为了现代视频平台上的主流格式[11],它通常包含更丰富的叙事和比短片更动态的场景过渡;因此,它对于实际应用来说更有价值[48].

blocks.en:
Despite its practical importance, long video out-painting remains highly challenging.
A direct solution would be to process an entire long video jointly.
However, due to the high computational and memory cost of video generation models, handling long sequences in a single pass is often impractical.
A more natural and scalable alternative is iterative out-painting, i.e. , dividing the video into temporal chunks and generating them sequentially [ 50 ] .
This strategy enables existing short-video models to be extended to longer videos without fundamentally changing their architectures.
blocks.zh:
尽管其实际重要性,长视频外涂仍极具挑战性。
一个直接的解决办法是联合处理整个长视频。
然而,由于视频生成模型的计算和内存成本高,在单行道中处理长序往往不切实际.
一个比较自然和可扩展的替代品是迭接出画,即将视频分出为时块并相继生成 [50].
这一策略使得现有的短视频模型能够被扩展至更长的视频而不会从根本上改变其架构.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustration of the two main challenges in long video out-painting: (a) unstable generation including abrupt transitions, brightness flickering, and even complete generation collapse caused by accumulated errors, and (b) semantic drift like changed scene layouts, unstable object identities, or inconsistent subject appearances over long time. Both cases are generated by VACE model [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 图一 长相视频出画中两大挑战的图解:(a) 不稳定的生成,包括突然过渡,亮度闪烁,甚至因累积出错而导致的完整生成倒塌; (b) 语义漂移,如场景布局变化,物体身份不稳定,或主题出现长期不一致. 这两个案例都是由VACE模型[22]所产生.

blocks.en:
However, simply applying chunk-by-chunk generation introduces two major challenges over long horizons.
First, consistency across neighboring chunks is difficult to preserve, often causing abrupt transitions, brightness flickering, and progressively accumulated errors that may eventually lead to complete generation collapse.
As shown in Fig. 1 (a), the out-painting on the left and right sides gradually collapses due to accumulated errors, resulting in excessive color spill and completely abstract objects.
Second, as the temporal horizon grows longer, the generated content tends to drift semantically, resulting in changed scene layouts, unstable object identities, or inconsistent subject appearances over time.
For example, in Fig. 1 (b), the model initially out-painted a human hand, but the hand gradually transforms into a lizard body over a long period.
blocks.zh:
然而,仅仅逐个使用一代就提出了长期存在的两大挑战。
首先,各相邻块之间的一致性很难保持,常常造成突变,亮度闪烁,并逐渐积累出错误,最终可能导致整个生成倒塌.
如图一(a)所显示,左侧和右侧外出涂料会因累积出错而逐渐倒塌,导致过度的色彩外溢和完全抽象的对象.
第二,随着时间平面的扩大,所生成的内容往往会成群地漂移,导致场景布局的改变,物体身份的不稳定,或者主题外观随时间推移而不一致.
例如,在图1(b)中,模型最初会将人手涂出,但手在很长一段时间内会逐渐转变为蜥蜴体.

blocks.en: To address the above problems, we introduce LongSCOP , a S emantically C onsistent long video O ut- P ainting method, tackling long video out-painting from two aspects: stable long-horizon generation and semantic consistency preservation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决上述问题,我们引入了LongSCOP,一种S emantial C istent long video O ut-P ainting方法,从两个方面解决了长视频出画问题:稳定的长视距生成和语义一致性保存.

blocks.en:
One fundamental requirement for long video out-painting is to maintain smooth and stable long-horizon generation, avoiding abrupt transitions, brightness flickering, and generation collapse ( i.e. , caused by accumulated errors).
To this end, we propose a long-horizon stabilization strategy for iterative out-painting from three aspects.
First, we adopt a self-forcing training scheme [ 21 ] , where the model uses its own predictions as references during training, so that the training process is better aligned with inference-time iterative generation.
Second, we introduce latent calibration by normalizing the predicted latents, which constrains their distribution from drifting too far away and thus reduces the risk of error accumulation and generation collapse.
Third, instead of relying only on the out-painted results from the previous chunk as a reference, we further incorporate future references to provide richer temporal guidance and improve the stability of long-range generation.
blocks.zh:
长相视频出漆的一个基本要求是保持平滑而稳定的长视距生成,避免突然过渡,亮度闪烁和生成崩溃(即由累积出的错误所引起).
为此,我们提议一项长期稳定战略,从三个方面进行迭接。
首先,我们采用自我强制培训计划[21],即模型在培训期间使用自己的预测作为参考,从而使培训过程与推论时间迭代生成更加一致.
第二,我们通过使预测的潜在物正常化来进行潜在校正,从而限制其分布,使其远离漂移,从而减少出错积累和生成倒塌的风险。
第三,我们不只依靠前一个块的外涂结果作为参考,而是进一步纳入未来的参考,以提供更丰富的时间指导并改进长程发电的稳定性。

blocks.en:
Another, more advanced requirement is semantic consistency, i.e. , subjects, scenes, and backgrounds should remain consistent over long temporal horizons.
Even with smooth and stable long-horizon generation, individual subjects may gradually and seamlessly transform into entirely different ones as generation proceeds, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b).
To address this issue, we recognize that the rich context of a long video provides a valuable source of visual references for maintaining semantic consistency.
While temporally adjacent reference frames help maintain local continuity and smooth transitions between consecutive chunks, such local references become insufficient over long temporal horizons.
They mainly provide short-range motion and appearance cues, but often fail to preserve subject identity and scene semantics across distant chunks.
We therefore build an agent based on Vision Language Models (VLMs) [ 2 , 28 , 32 , 39 , 6 , 52 , 15 ] that searches the entire video and automatically selects reference frames with the most informative semantic cues, providing global guidance for semantically consistent long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh:
另一个更先进的要求是语义上的一致性,即主题,场景和背景在较长的时间范围上应该保持一致性.
即使有平滑而稳定的长相相位生成,个别主体也可能随着生成过程而逐渐而无缝地转变为完全不同的主体,如图1(b)所示.
为了解决这一问题,我们认识到,长视频的丰富背景为保持语义一致性提供了宝贵的视觉参考来源。
虽然时间相邻的参考框架有助于保持本地连续性和相接块之间的平稳过渡,但这种本地参考在较长的时间范围内变得不足。
它们主要提供短程运动和外观提示,但往往无法在相距遥远的块上保留主题身份和场景语义.
因此,我们建立了一个基于VLMs(VLMs)[2,28,32,39,6,52,15]的代理,搜索整个视频,并自动选择信息最丰富的语义提示的参考框,为模拟一致长视距生成提供全球指导.

blocks.en:
To train and evaluate our LongSCOP, we collect a large-scale, high-quality training dataset and carefully construct a benchmark specifically for long-video out-painting.
Our training dataset covers a wide range of video genres, consisting of 62K video clips, and ensures high-quality and diverse content that is essential for robust training across complex, dynamic scenes.
The LVO-Bench benchmark, curated by human experts, includes representative video clips selected for their complexity and diversity, providing a comprehensive evaluation platform for testing the model’s ability to maintain semantic consistency and temporal coherence in challenging long-video generation scenarios.
blocks.zh:
为了培训和评估我们的长相卫星,我们收集了一个大规模、高质量的培训数据集,并精心构建了一个专门针对长相图像出漆的基准。
我们的培训数据集涵盖广泛的视频流派,由62K个视频片段组成,并确保高质量和多样的内容,这对于跨越复杂和动态场景的有力培训至关重要。
由人类专家编排的LVO-Bench基准包括了因其复杂性和多样性而选定的有代表性的视频剪辑,为测试该模型在挑战长视频生成情景中保持语义一致性和时间一致性的能力提供了一个全面的评价平台.

blocks.en:
Extensive experimental results show the performance advantages of our LongSCOP.
Specifically, in the LVO-Bench benchmark, we improve the FVD [ 36 ] by 28.19 points and PSNR by 0.92 dB compared to the previous best model.
The ablation experiments show the effectiveness of our proposed two main modules and the design choice of our key reference frame retrieval method.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验结果显示我们LongSCOP的性能优势.
具体来说,在LVO-Bench基准中,与之前的最佳模式相比,我们改进了FVD[36]分,提高了28.19分,PSNR提高了0.92分.
衰减试验显示我们提议的两个主要单元的有效性和我们关键参考框架检索方法的设计选择。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Video Generation Models. Early video diffusion models extend image diffusion architectures to the temporal domain by introducing temporal attention [ 42 ] , 3D convolutions, or latent video representations, enabling the synthesis of visually realistic and temporally coherent short clips [ 19 , 3 , 51 ] . Subsequent works improve generation quality and controllability by scaling training data [ 5 ] , model capacity, and conditioning signals, leading to increasingly capable text-to-video and image-to-video systems [ 18 , 34 , 16 ] . Recently, open large-scale video generation models such as Open-Sora Plan [ 27 ] and Wan [ 37 ] demonstrate strong generalization across diverse video creation tasks, and provide powerful foundation models for downstream video editing and completion.
In addition, to overcome the challenges of long-video generation and reduce the gap between training and inference, recent methods have explored auto-regressive generation, such as Diffusion Forcing [ 4 ] , Self Forcing [ 21 ] , and Rolling Forcing [ 29 ] . These methods have been shown to be effective in improving long-horizon video generation.
blocks.zh:
视频世代模式. 早期的视频传播模型将图像传播架构扩展至时间域,引入了时间关注[42],3D演化,或潜伏的视频表现,使视觉现实和时间上一致的短片集成[19,3,51]. 随后的作品通过对培训数据[5],模型容量,以及调制信号进行分级,提高生成质量和可控性,使文本到视频和图像到视频系统的能力日益增强[18,34,16]. 最近,Open-Sora Plan[27]和Wan [37]等开放式大型视频生成模型展现出不同视频创建任务的强烈概括,为下游视频编辑和完成提供了强大的基础模型.

blocks.en: Video Out-painting Video out-painting seeks to extend the spatial contents of a video beyond its initial boundaries. Existing methods usually focus on temporal consistency or stronger conditioning. Complete and Temporally Consistent Video Out-painting builds background estimates, uses optical flow for temporal consistency, and introduces image shifting to improve frame completion [ 8 ] . M3DDM is particularly relevant to our setting: it uses multiple guide frames to connect clip-level inference and extracts global frames of the video as prompts via cross-attention [ 12 ] . More recent out-painting methods strengthen guidance in other ways. MOTIA performs input-specific adaptation to learn source-video patterns [ 38 ] . Infinite-Canvas injects the source video and its relative positional relations into each spatial window [ 7 ] ; and Unboxed combines 3D-supported out-painting for static regions with dynamic object completion and guided video synthesis [ 48 ] . These methods show that stronger guidance beyond the current frame is beneficial, but they still do not formulate reference selection as a query-dependent retrieval problem over the full video timeline. Moreover, VACE [ 22 ] as a general video editing method could achieve video out-painting through specific mask design.
blocks.zh: 视频出画 视频出画试图将视频的空间内容扩展到其初始边界以外. 现有方法通常注重时间一致性或更强的调制. 完整和暂时一致的视频 出漆构建了背景估计,使用光学流来进行时间一致性,并引入了图像转换来改进帧完成 [8]. M3DDM与我们的设定特别相干:它使用多条导框连接剪接平面推论,并取出视频的全球帧作为通过交叉注意的提示 [12]. 较近期的外涂法以其他方式加强指导. MOTIA进行针对输入的适应,以学习源-视频模式[38]. Infinite-Canvas将源视频及其相对位置关系注入到每个空间窗口[7];而Unboxed结合了为静态区域提供的由3D支持的出漆,动态对象完成并引导视频合成[48]. 这些方法表明,超越当前框架的更强有力的指导是有好处的,但是它们仍然没有制定参考选择,作为整个视频时间段上依赖查询的检索问题. 此外,VACE[22]作为一种一般的视频编辑方法,可以通过特定的口罩设计实现视频出漆.

blocks.en:
Reference-driven Video Completion Recent work has also explored richer reference signals for video completion [ 53 ] . HomoGen [ 9 ] propagates contextual pixels via homography and injects them as priors into a video diffusion model.
VideoRepainter [ 17 ] uses a user-edited key frame as an explicit reference and propagates its semantics to the remaining frames.
These methods confirm the value of strong external guidance, but the guidance is either geometrically propagated or manually specified, rather than automatically retrieved from the source video according to the semantic needs.
blocks.zh:
参考驱动视频完成 最近的工作还探索了更丰富的视频完成参考信号[53]. HomoGen [9]通过同谱法传播上下文像素,并将其作为前身注入到视频传播模型中.
VideoRepainter [17] 使用用户编辑的密钥框作为明确的参考,并传播其语义到其余框.
这些方法证实了强大的外向引导的价值,但引导要么是几何传播的,要么是手工指定的,而不是根据语义需要从源视频中自动取出.

VACE for Video Out-painting We could design inputs I = { T , V i ​ n , M } I=\{T,V_{in},M\} to achieve video out-painting using the VACE model.
For input video V i ​ n V_{in} , we zero-pad the original video to the out-painting target resolution, thus the input video V i ​ n V_{in} will have black borders as in Fig. 2 .
For masks M M , we assign the mask values of the original region as 0, meaning these pixels should be kept.
The mask values of the out-painted region ( i.e. , the black border) are assigned as 1, indicating that they should be generated.
The textual prompts T T are obtained by VLM captioning on the original video.
With above designed inputs, VACE could serve as a baseline model for video out-painting.

VACE Out-painting with Reference Frames If we have an out-painted frame with the target resolution, an intuitive idea is to treat the out-painted frame as the reference frame to guide a smooth and continuous editing.
We could achieve this simply by appending an out-painted frame before the input video V i ​ n V_{in} and an all 0 mask before the masks M M , since the all 0 mask means that all pixels should be kept and unchanged.
Multiple reference frames could be added in the same way.
blocks.zh:
瓦努阿图 外绘参考框架 如果我们有一个带有目标分辨率的出漆框架,一个直观的想法是将出漆框架作为参考框架来指导平稳而持续的编辑.
我们只需在输入视频V i n-V_{in}之前附加一个外涂框, 在口罩M M 之前加上一个全部0个口罩就可以实现这一点, 因为所有0个口罩都意味着所有像素都应该保持并保持不变.
可以用同样的方式添加多个参考框架。

blocks.en:
VACE Chunk-by-Chunk Out-painting With the above preliminaries, we could implement a chunk-by-chunk video out-painting pipeline.
For a long input video, we first divide it into several consecutive chunks and apply VACE out-painting to each chunk in temporal order.
The generated results from previous chunks are then used as reference frames for subsequent chunks, forming a simple chunk-by-chunk baseline for long video out-painting.
blocks.zh:
瓦努阿图 相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 有了上述的预告, 我们可以实施一个逐个的视频出漆管道。
对于一个长的输入视频,我们首先将它分为几个连续的块,并且按时间顺序将VACE外绘应用到每个块上.
然后将以往块生成的结果用作后续块的参考框架,形成一个简单的逐个块基线,用于长视频出漆.

blocks.en: 3.2 Foundation: Smooth and Stable Long-Horizon Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 基础:平稳而稳定的长相相生

blocks.en:
A fundamental requirement for long video out-painting is to ensure smooth and stable long-horizon generation, avoiding abrupt transitions, brightness flickering, and generation collapse caused by accumulated errors.
However, as the generation proceeds over time, the out-painted regions gradually degrade due to error accumulation, leading to severe color spillover and distorted structures (See Fig. 1 (a)).
To address this, we propose a long-horizon stabilization strategy for iterative out-painting.
blocks.zh:
长相视频外涂的一个基本要求是确保平滑而稳定的长相相相机生成,避免突然过渡,亮相闪烁,以及由累积出的错误所引发的相机倒塌.
然而,随着世代相传的生成,出漆区域由于出错的积累而逐渐退化,导致颜色严重外溢和结构扭曲(见图1(a))。
为了解决这个问题,我们提出了长期稳定战略,以反复地进行外涂。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Illustration of self-forcing training. During training, we use the model-predicted frames as reference frames, which could reduce the gap between training and inference.
blocks.zh: 图2:自我强制培训说明。 在培训期间,我们使用模型预测的框架作为参考框架,这可以缩小培训和推断之间的差距。

blocks.en: Self-forcing Training with Model-predicted References Chunk-by-chunk video out-painting requires auto-regressive generation across multiple chunks, making training-inference mismatch a major source of error accumulation. During training, if the model always conditions on ground-truth history frames, it only observes clean reference inputs. At inference time, however, later chunks depend on previously generated outputs, which inevitably contain noise and bias. This discrepancy grows over time and leads to unstable long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh: 与模型预设的自我执行培训 参考文献 Chunk-by-chunk 视频出画需要跨多块自动回转生成,使训练-推导不匹配成为出错累积的主要来源. 在培训期间,如果模型总是以地面真实历史框架为条件,它只遵守干净的参考资料。 然而,在推论中,后期块取决于以前产生的产出,这些产出不可避免地含有噪音和偏差. 这种差异随时间推移而扩大并导致不稳定的长视距生成.

blocks.en: To reduce this gap, inspired by [ 21 ] , as depicted in Fig. 2 , we introduce a self-forcing training strategy. During training, we construct two consecutive chunks. The model first performs online out-painting on the first chunk and produces predicted latent representations. These latents are then decoded into pixel space through the VAE decoder, and the last several generated frames are pre-pended to the second chunk as prefix conditions. Importantly, these prefix frames are not out-painted again; instead, they serve only as temporal conditioning signals. By exposing the model to its own predictions during training, self-forcing better aligns training with auto-regressive inference and improves long-range stability.
blocks.zh: 如图2所描述的,为了缩小这一差距,我们在[21]的启发下,实行了自我强制训练战略。 在训练期间,我们连续建造了两块. 该模型首先对第一个块进行在线外涂并产生预测的潜在表述。 这些潜伏物再通过VAE解码器解码为像素空间,最后几个生成的框架作为前缀条件被预刻到第二块. 重要的是,这些前缀框不再被外涂;相反,它们只是时间调节信号. 通过在训练期间将模型暴露在自己的预测上,自强制能更好地将训练与自发后退推论相配合,并增强远程稳定性.

blocks.en:
Latent Calibration A second source of error accumulation comes from the latent distribution shift over time.
In long-video chunk-wise inference, generated frames must be repeatedly written back and re-encoded into latent space. Such repeated operations can progressively distort latent statistics, causing degradation in brightness, saturation, contrast, and texture fidelity.
blocks.zh:
后期校正 误差累积的第二个来源是潜在分布随时间推移而变化。
在长视频分块的推断中,生成的帧必须被反复回写并被重新编码为潜在空间. 这种重复操作会逐渐扭曲潜在的统计,造成亮度、饱和度、对比度和纹理忠贞度的退化。

In this way, the latent space remains close to the original real-video statistics throughout long-horizon generation, which reduces long-term quality degradation and lowers the risk of generation collapse.
Note that the latent calibration is conducted during both self-forcing training and inference process.

blocks.en: Bidirectional Reference In standard chunk-wise inference, the current chunk usually conditions only on past frames. Although such one-sided conditioning helps maintain local temporal smoothness, it does not provide any information about future content. As a result, the content synthesized in the current chunk may become inconsistent with future chunks, leading to flickering and semantic discontinuities near chunk boundaries.
blocks.zh: 双向引用 在标准块法推论中,当前块通常只在过去的帧上附加条件. 虽然这种片面的调制有助于保持局部时间的平滑,但它并没有提供有关未来内容的任何信息. 因此,当前块所合成的内容可能与未来块不相符合,导致块边界附近的闪烁和语义不连续。

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce bidirectional reference chunk inference.
When out-painting the current chunk, we not only condition on historical frames but also include a small set of future frames as auxiliary references.
The future reference could be implemented by a quite simple inference trick without the need of retraining .
Specifically, during inference, we increase the input video length to cover a longer time than the current chunk.
After out-painting, we keep only the outputs corresponding to the current chunk and discard the results of future frames.
Although simple, this strategy allows the model to access a broader temporal context and anticipate scene evolution during generation, effectively reducing boundary inconsistency.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们采用双向的参考块推论。
出出当前块时,我们不仅以历史框架为条件,而且还包括了一小组未来框架作为辅助参考.
将来的提法可以通过一个相当简单的推论来实施,而不需要再培训。
具体地说,在推论期间,我们增加输入视频长度,以覆盖比当前块更长的时间.
在外涂后,我们只保留与当前块对应的输出,并丢弃未来帧的结果.
虽然很简单,但这一策略使得模型能够访问更广泛的时间背景并预想出在生成过程中的场景演化,从而有效减少边界不一致.

blocks.en: 3.3 Advance: Semantic Consistency via Key Reference Frame Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.3 推进:语义一致性 密钥引用框架检索

blocks.en:
Even with smooth and stable long-horizon generation, some subjects may gradually drift into totally different ones as generation proceeds, as shown in Fig. 1 (b).
Therefore, a more advanced requirement is semantic consistency, i.e. , the subjects, scenes, and backgrounds should remain consistent over long temporal horizons.
Here we show that good reference frames could provide semantically consistent information, and design a method to automatically select the most suitable reference frames.
blocks.zh:
即使在平滑而稳定的长视距生成的情况下,一些主体也可能会随着生成过程而逐渐变成完全不同的主体,如图1(b)所示.
因此,更先进的要求是语义上的一致性,即主题、场景和背景在较长的时间范围内应当保持一致性。
在这里,我们表明,良好的参考框架可以提供整体一致的信息,并设计一种方法来自动选择最合适的参考框架.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Illustration of the importance of suitable reference frame.
Adding only one reference frame could significantly improve the out-painting performance of the whole video by nearly 70 FVD points and more than 1.1 dB PSNR on average.
blocks.zh:
图3 说明适当参考框架的重要性。
仅添加一个参考框架就可以显著地使整个视频的外绘性能得到近70个FVD点和平均超过1.1 dB PSNR.

blocks.en: What a Good Reference Can Do We restrict reference frames to real frames sampled from the input video, rather than using externally generated images. This design has two advantages. First, it avoids introducing synthetic artifacts or additional distribution mismatch. Second, these frames naturally share the same subjects, scene layout, and visual style as the target video, making them more suitable as conditioning signals for out-painting. For long videos, relying only on temporally adjacent history frames provides local continuity but is often insufficient for preserving global semantics over long horizons. In contrast, well-chosen reference frames can provide complementary structural cues, appearance information, and contextual semantics, thereby mitigating facial distortion, background inconsistency, and semantic drift across chunks.
blocks.zh: 多好的参考罐 执行 我们把参考框架限制在从输入视频中抽取的实际框架,而不是使用外部生成的图像。 这种设计有两个优点. 首先,它避免引入合成文物或额外的分配不匹配. 其次,这些相框自然地与目标视频具有相同的主题,场景布局,和视觉风格,使得它们更适合作为外出绘画的取材信号. 对于长相的视频来说,仅依靠时间相邻的历史框架可以提供局部连续性,但往往不足以在长相上保存全球语义. 相形之下,精选的参考框可以提供互补的结构提示,外观信息,和上下文语义,从而减轻面部扭曲,背景不一致,语义漂移到块之间.

blocks.en:
We demonstrate the effectiveness of reference frames on LVO-Bench benchmark by comparing each sample with and without reference frames across multiple metrics in Fig. 3 .
Here the reference frames are sampled from the input video at one frame per second.
We report the gains obtained by the best reference frames of each sample.
As shown in Fig. 3 , most samples (around 83% to 86%) achieve better results with reference frames than without them across all metrics.
In particular, adding only one reference frame could significantly improve the out-painting performance of the whole video by nearly 70 FVD and more than 1.1 dB PSNR on average, indicating a substantial gain in video quality.
blocks.zh:
我们通过比照图3中多个指标的每个样本和没有参照基准,证明LVO-Bench基准的参照基准的有效性。
这里的参考框架以每秒一帧的方式取自输入视频.
我们报告每个样本的最佳参考框架所取得的成果。
如图3所示,大多数样本(约83%至86%)的参考基准比所有指标的参考基准的参考基准要好。
特别是,只增加一个参考框架,就能够大大地改善整个视频的外涂性能,平均有近70个FVD,超过1.1个dB PSNR,表明视频质量大有提高.

blocks.en:
What Makes a Good Reference Frame Our analysis suggests that a good reference frame should satisfy two key properties: appropriate spatial overlap and information usefulness .
Spatial overlap determines whether the candidate frame can be reliably aligned with the query chunk, while information usefulness indicates whether the candidate provides content that is truly helpful for recovering the missing out-painting region.
These two properties are complementary: the former ensures usable geometric correspondence, and the latter ensures effective contextual guidance.
blocks.zh:
是什么使一个良好的参考框架 我们的分析表明,良好的参考框架应满足两个关键特性:适当的空间重叠和信息用途。
空间重叠决定了候选框架是否能够与查询块可靠地对接,而信息实用性则表明候选框架是否提供了真正有助于恢复缺失的外绘区域的内容.
这两个属性是相辅相成的:前者确保可用的几何通信,而后者确保有效的背景指导.

blocks.en:
Spatial overlap reflects the degree of shared visual content between the candidate reference frame and the query chunk.
If the overlap is too large, the candidate frame mostly repeats the already visible region and contributes limited new information for out-painting.
If the overlap is too small, the candidate may become difficult to align with the query chunk, making its structural guidance unreliable or even misleading.
Therefore, an effective reference frame should maintain a moderate overlap, balancing reliable spatial correspondence with sufficient complementary context.
blocks.zh:
空间重叠反映了候选参考框架和查询块之间共享视觉内容的程度。
如果重叠太大,则候选框架大多重复已经可见的区域,并且为外涂提供了有限的新信息。
如果重叠太小,候选人可能难以与查询块保持一致,使其结构指导不可靠,甚至误导。
因此,有效的参考框架应保持适度的重叠,兼顾可靠的空间对应和充分的互补背景。

blocks.en:
Information usefulness measures whether the complementary content provided by the reference frame is actually beneficial for the missing region.
Even when a candidate frame has an appropriate spatial overlap, it may still be less useful if its newly introduced content is irrelevant to the area to be out-painted.
A good reference should not only introduce additional content, but also provide the right contextual cues needed for out-painting.
Thus, the most valuable reference frames are those that are both spatially compatible with the query chunk and informative for the target missing region.
blocks.zh:
信息有用性衡量参考框架提供的补充内容是否对缺失区域实际有益。
即使候选框架有适当的空间重叠,如果其新引入的内容与需要外涂的区域无关,其用途可能仍然不大.
一个很好的参考不仅应引入更多的内容,而且还应提供出漆所需的正确背景提示。
因此,最有价值的参照基准是那些既与查询块在空间上兼容,又为目标缺失区域提供信息的参照基准。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Illustration of key reference frame retrieval framework.
Given query frames from current query chunk to be out-painted and candidate frames from both history chunk and future chunk, we aim to find the most suitable reference frames to out-paint current chunk.
Specifically, we calculate the registration maps and scores for all query-candidate pairs, and then input them into a VLM, Qwen3.5-VL-27B [ 32 ] .
The VLM is requested to understand the whole video, speculate the missing contents ( i.e. , contents to out-paint like the two women and the indoor background), analyze which candidate frames may contain such missing contents, finally select the most suitable reference frames.
blocks.zh:
图4:关键参考框架检索框架说明。
鉴于来自当前查询块的查询框架将被涂出,来自历史块和未来块的候选框架将被涂出,我们的目标是找到最合适的用于出行当前块的参考框架。
具体来说,我们计算所有查询扫描对的注册地图和分数,然后输入VLM,Qwen3.5-VL-27B[32].
VLM被请求来理解整个视频,推测缺失的内容(即像两个女性和室内背景一样的内容外出),分析哪些候选帧可能包含这些缺失的内容,最后选择最合适的参考帧.

blocks.en:
How to Get a Good Reference Frame Based on the above observations, we introduce a geometry-guided and semantics-aware reference retrieval method.
For each query chunk, we uniformly sample four query frames to capture its missing-region context, and then extract candidate frames from the full video at fixed temporal intervals and rank them through a two-stage procedure.
blocks.zh:
基于上述观测结果,我们引入了几何制导和语义感知的参考检索方法。
对于每个查询块,我们统一抽取了四个查询框来捕捉其缺失的区域背景,然后在固定的时间间隔从整个视频中取出候选的帧,并通过两个阶段的程序进行排序.

blocks.en:
In the first stage, we focus on the appropriate spatial overlap .
As depicted in Fig. 4 , we first use the image registration model Mast3R [ 26 ] to estimate the spatial relationship between each query frame and candidate frame.
Mast3R produces registration scores that reflect the degree of geometric match.
We use these scores to remove poorly aligned candidates ( i.e. , bottom 30% of poorly aligned candidates) before semantic reasoning.
This geometric filtering stage substantially reduces the search space and ensures that the remaining candidates satisfy a basic level of spatial compatibility.
blocks.zh:
在第一阶段,我们侧重于适当的空间重叠。
如图4所描述,我们首先使用图像注册模型Mast3R[26]来估计每个查询框架和候选框架之间的空间关系.
Mast3R产生能反映几何匹配程度的注册分数.
在语义推理之前,我们用这些分数来去除不合格候选人(即不合格候选人中排名倒数30%).
这个几何过滤阶段会大大缩短搜索空间,并确保所余考生满足基本的空间相容程度.

blocks.en:
In the second stage, the main target is information usefulness .
Since information usefulness is hard to measure by a simple metric, we resort to a VLM, Qwen3.5-VL-27B [ 32 ] .
Unlike registration scores, which mainly reflect geometric similarity, the VLM can reason about which visual cues are missing in the out-painting region and whether a candidate frame can provide those cues [ 1 , 44 , 46 , 45 , 47 ] .
Specifically, as shown in Fig. 4 , the VLM jointly examines the query frames, candidate frames, and registration maps and scores to determine whether a candidate can supply informative appearance, structural, or contextual content for out-painting.
This cascaded design, geometry-guided filtering followed by semantics-aware reasoning, improves both retrieval efficiency and selection accuracy.
The selected key reference frame is then fed into the model as an additional condition for generation.
blocks.zh:
在第二阶段,主要目标是信息实用性。
由于信息有用性很难用一个简单的度量标准来衡量,我们采用VLM,Qun3.5-VL-27B[32].
与主要反映几何相似性的注册分数不同的是,VLM可以说明在外绘区缺失了哪些视觉提示,以及候选框是否能够提供这些提示[1,44,46,45,47].
具体地说,如图4所示,VLM联合审查查询框架、候选框架、注册地图和分数,以确定候选人是否能够提供信息外观、结构或背景内容。
这种级联设计,几何-导滤接后再进行语义-知觉推理,既能提高检索效率和选择精度.
然后将选定的关键参考框架输入模型,作为生成的附加条件。

blocks.en:
Joint Training with Selected Key Reference Frame Rather than using the selected key reference frames only as a test-time plug-in, we incorporate them into the training stage to make the out-painting model better adapted to reference-guided generation.
Specifically, we sample a subset of training videos and construct training chunks with their retrieved key reference frames, following the same reference-format design used in inference.
The selected frame is appended to the input video as an additional reference condition with an all-zero mask, so that the model learns to exploit its visual cues while keeping the reference content unchanged.
This joint training strategy exposes the model to the same type of selected reference conditions during optimization and inference, reducing the mismatch between training and inference.
blocks.zh:
与选定的关键参考框架进行联合培训,而不是仅将选定的关键参考框架用作试验时间插接,而是将它们纳入培训阶段,使出涂模式更能适应参考指南生成。
具体地说,我们根据在推断中使用的同样的参考格式设计,抽取了一组培训录像,并用检索到的关键参考框架构建培训块。
所选框被附在输入视频后,作为附加的参考条件,并带有全零口罩,使模型学习利用其视觉提示,同时保持参考内容不变.
这种联合培训战略使模型在优化和推论期间暴露出同一类选定的参考条件,减少了培训和推论之间的不匹配.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset and Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和基准建设

blocks.en:
Training Dataset Collection (a) Source video collection .
To construct a high-quality training dataset, we collect a large amount of high-resolution videos covering diverse categories, including portraits, architecture, animals, plants, and natural scenes.
After removing videos with black borders, low effective resolution, insufficient bitrate, or visible compression artifacts, we segment videos into scenes using PySceneDetect [ 31 ] and retain scenes longer than 64 frames at 24 FPS.
We then evaluate each clip by frame quality and scene dynamics, where frame quality is measured by averaged MUSIQ [ 23 ] and LAION-Aesthetics [ 25 ] scores from frames sampled at 3 FPS, and scene dynamics are measured by RAFT optical-flow magnitude [ 35 ] .
By jointly ranking these criteria, we select 62K high-quality clips.
All selected clips are down-sampled by a factor of two and extracted at 24 FPS as individual frames for subsequent training.
(b) Video captioning .
For each clip, we further obtain a textual caption using VLM captioning [ 32 ] , which is used as the textual prompt for training.
(c) Random mask for video out-painting .
Based on these high-quality videos, we construct video out-painting training samples by applying random exterior masks.
Specifically, we randomly apply the random mask strategy using a mask ratio between 0.25 and 0.66.
The unmasked region is always constrained to be a complete rectangle, corresponding to the original visible video content, while the masked region only appears outside this rectangle.
This design matches the practical setting of video out-painting and allows the model to generalize to diverse out-painting ratios and spatial layouts.
blocks.zh:
培训数据集收集(a) 源视频收集
为了构建一个高质量的培训数据集,我们收集了大量高分辨率视频,涵盖包括肖像、建筑、动物、植物和自然场景在内的不同类别。
在删除了带有黑色边框,低效分辨率,比特率不足,或者可见压缩文物的视频后,我们利用PyScene Detect [31] 将视频分入场景,并在24 FPS保留了超过64帧的场景.
然后,我们通过帧质量和场景动态来评价每段片段,其中帧质量用平均MUSIQ [23] 和LAION-美学[25] 从在3 FPS取样的帧分数来测量,场景动态用RAFT光学流度来测量 [35].
通过共同排名这些标准,我们选择了62K高品质的剪辑.
所有所选剪辑均由二分之一的系数下取出,取自24 FPS,作为后续训练的单个帧.
(b) 录像字幕
对于每个片段,我们使用VLM字幕进一步获得文本字幕 [32],作为培训的文本提示.
(c) 视频外涂的随机口罩。
基于这些高品质的视频,我们用随机外罩构建出视频外涂培训样本.
具体来说,我们使用0.25到0.66之间的口罩比,随机应用了随机口罩策略.
被蒙面的区域总是被限制为一个完整的矩形,对应了原始可见的视频内容,而被蒙面的区域只出现在这个矩形之外.
这种设计与视频出漆的实际设置相匹配,使模型能够被概括到不同的出漆比例和空间布局.

blocks.en: Existing Benchmarks To verify the effectiveness of LongSCOP, we conduct evaluations on DAVIS [ 30 ] and YouTube-VOS [ 43 ] , which are widely used benchmarks for video out-painting. Following M3DDM [ 12 ] , we compare the results of different methods in the horizontal direction, using mask ratios of 0.25 and 0.66.
blocks.zh: 现有基准 为了验证LongSCOP的有效性,我们对DAVIS[30]和YouTube-VOS[43]进行了评价,这些评价被广泛用于视频出漆的基准. 继M3DDM [12]之后,我们用0.25和0.66的口罩比率比较了横向方向不同方法的结果.

blocks.en: LVO-Bench Benchmark Construction We construct our LVO-Bench benchmark (short for L ong V ideo O ut-painting) from existing LongVideoBench [ 41 ] and Video-MME [ 13 ] benchmarks using a multi-stage filtering pipeline designed specifically for reference-based long-video out-painting. We first apply scene boundary detection to split each source video into temporally coherent shots, and retain only sufficiently long segments so that temporally distant reference retrieval is meaningful. We then remove degenerate cases with little visual change over time, such as news-style or talking-head footage, by sampling frames, uniformly within each segment and measuring content variation together with motion statistics. Segments with insufficient temporal change are discarded, as are clips with overly violent motion that would make the task ill-posed.
blocks.zh: LVO- Bench 基准建设 我们从现有的LongVideo Bench [41] 和Video-MME [13] 基准中构建我们的LVO-Bench基准(Long Video O ut-painting的简称),使用一个专门为基于参考的长视频出漆设计的多阶段过滤管道。 我们首先应用场景边界探测,将每个源视频分解成时间上一致的镜头,只保留足够长的片段,这样时间上距离的参考检索才有意义. 然后,我们通过采样框,在每一段内统一地去除不易发生视觉变化的退化病例,例如新闻式或谈话头镜头,并结合运动统计来衡量内容变化。 时间变化不够的片段被丢弃,带有过度暴力动作的片段被丢弃,使任务无法承担。

blocks.en: To ensure suitability for left-right out-painting, we further apply geometric validation. We estimate inter-frame motion using optical flow and robust point tracking, and retain clips with stable horizontal camera motion, limited rotation, and small scale drift. We then verify whether temporally distant frames can align with target frames and provide sufficient recoverable content near the left or right borders. Clips with unreliable geometry or weak recoverable regions are discarded. As a result, LVO-Bench focuses on long, dynamic, and geometrically valid videos where reference-frame retrieval is both necessary and useful.
blocks.zh: 为了确保适合左外出涂料,我们进一步应用几何验证. 我们利用光学流和强点跟踪来估计机身间运动,并保留有稳定水平相机运动,有限度自转和小尺度漂移的片段. 然后,我们核实在时间上距离遥远的帧是否能够与目标帧一致,在左边或右边边界附近提供足够的可回收内容。 几何学不可靠或可回收区域薄弱的剪贴被丢弃。 因此,LVO-Bench专注于长,动态,几何有效的视频,其中参考框架检索既必要又有用.

blocks.en:
Benchmark Composition and Scene Diversity The final LVO-Bench contains 52 video cases, with durations ranging from approximately 5 seconds to more than 20 seconds.
We examine its diversity along two complementary dimensions: scene environment and camera shot scale.
The benchmark contains 26 indoor and 26 outdoor videos.
It also includes 3 close-up, 36 medium-shot, and 13 long-shot videos.
These counts describe two categorizations of the same 52 cases.
The combination of different environments, framing scales, and temporal lengths provides varied conditions for evaluating long-range reference retrieval and video out-painting.

基准构成和场景多样性 最终的LVO-Bench包含52个视频案例,持续时间从大约5秒到20多秒不等.
我们从两个相辅相成的方面来审查它的多样性:场景环境和相机拍摄尺度。
该基准包含26个室内视频和26个室外视频.
它还包括了3个特写,36个中镜头和13个长镜头.
这些罪名说明了同一52个案件的两种分类。
不同环境、框架尺度和时间长度相结合,为评价远程参考检索和视频外绘提供了各种条件。

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量和执行细节

blocks.en: Metrics Our evaluation approach utilizes four well-established metrics: Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) [ 40 ] , Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) [ 49 ] , and Frechet Video Distance (FVD) [ 36 ] . For assessing PSNR, SSIM, and FVD, the generated videos are converted into frames within a normalized value range of [0, 1]. LPIPS is evaluated over a range of [-1, 1]. About the FVD metric, we adopt a uniform frame sampling, with 16 frames per video for evaluation following M3DDM [ 12 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 计量 我们的评价方法使用四个既定的衡量标准: 峰信号到噪声比(PSNR),结构相近指数度量(SSIM)[40],所学概念相近相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 为了评估PSNR,SSIM,和FVD,生成的视频被转换成在[0, 1]等正态值范围内的帧. LPIPS的评价范围为[-1, 1]. 关于FVD度量衡,我们采用统一的帧抽样,每段视频有16个帧用于在M3DDM[12,14]之后进行评估.

blocks.en: Implementation Details Our model is built upon and initialized from VACE-1.3B [ 22 ] . The LoRA [ 20 ] technique is adopted. The LoRA rank r r and LoRA α \alpha are set to 16 and 8, respectively. The low-rank adapters are trained using the Adam optimizer [ 24 ] . We set the learning rate to 0.0001, and set the weight decay to 0.01. The model is trained on 8 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs for 20 hours.

blocks.en:
Ablation of Key Reference Retrieval Methods To systematically evaluate the design choices in the retrieval module, we construct a set of implementation variants about candidate filtering strategy, the use of registration-derived auxiliary information, and the organization of VLM reasoning.
Specifically, we consider the following variants: (1) using manually selected reference frames as an upper-bound baseline; (2) feeding all candidate frames and the four query frames into the VLM for direct retrieval; (3) filtering out the bottom 30% of candidates according to registration scores before passing the remaining candidates and query frames to the VLM; (4) filtering out the bottom 50% of candidates according to registration scores before passing the remaining candidates and query frames to the VLM; (5) filtering out the bottom 30% of candidates before VLM reasoning, and input registration scores; (6) filtering out the bottom 50% of candidates before VLM reasoning, and input registration scores and rank information; (7) filtering out the bottom 30% of candidates and additionally providing registration scores, rank information, and registration visualizations to the VLM.
These variants span a spectrum from purely geometry-based selection to deep integration of geometric filtering and semantic reasoning, allowing us to isolate the contribution of each design choice.
blocks.zh:
关键参考检索方法 为了系统地评价检索模块中的设计选择,我们构建了一套关于候选过滤战略、使用登记衍生辅助信息以及组织VLM推理的执行变体。
具体来说,我们考虑以下变式:(1) 使用人工选取的参考框架作为上限基线;(2) 将所有候选框架和四个查询框架输入VLM进行直接检索;(3) 根据登记分数过滤候选人底部30%,然后将剩下的候选人和查询分数传递到VLM;(4) 根据登记分数过滤候选人底部50%,然后将剩下的候选人和查询分数传递到VLM;(5) 在VLM推理前过滤候选人底部30%,输入登记分数和排名信息;(7) 过滤候选人底部30%,并另外向VLM提供登记分数、排名信息和登记可视化。
这些变体跨出从纯粹以几何为主的选择到几何滤取和语义推理的深度融合,使我们能够孤立每个设计选择的贡献.

blocks.en: As demonstrated in Tab. 5 , Variant (7) achieves the best agreement with the reference-frame rankings derived from objective generation metrics, yielding the strongest performance on HiT and Recall. We therefore adopt Variant (7) as the final design: we first filter out the bottom 30% of candidates using registration scores, and then provide the remaining candidates, query frames, registration ranking information and registration visualizations to the VLM. This result suggests that moderate geometric filtering is effective at removing clearly invalid candidates, while explicit rank-aware registration cues help the VLM focus on references that are both spatially alignable and semantically informative.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所显示. 5,变式(7)与基于客观生成度量衡的参照框架排名取得最佳一致,在HIT和Recall上表现最强. 因此,我们采用备选案文(7)作为最后设计:我们首先利用登记分数筛选出最底层30%的候选人,然后向VLM提供其余的候选人、查询框架、登记排名信息和登记可视化。 这一结果表明,适度的几何过滤可以有效地清除明显无效的候选人,而明确的有分级意识的注册提示则有助于VLM将注意力集中在既具有空间一致性又具有翔实信息的参考文献上。

Generality across VLMs and registration models. Our reference retrieval framework separates geometric filtering from semantic reasoning.

We evaluate Mast3R and RoMa [ 10 ] for registration, together with Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-27B for semantic reasoning.

基准外的两个真实世界视频进一步支持质量稳健性.

blocks.en:
Sensitivity to geometric filtering. We vary the fraction of registration-filtered candidates from 20% to 80%, keeping other components fixed.
As shown in Tab. 7 , removing 30% achieves the best Recall@5 (0.5265) and nDCG@3 (0.6115), while tying the best Hit@3 (0.6744).
Aggressive filtering removes useful candidates and gradually reduces retrieval accuracy.
blocks.zh:
对几何过滤的敏感性. 我们把被过滤的注册候选人的比例从20%到80%不等,保持其他组件的固定。
如塔布所显示. 7,去除30%实现最佳回击@5 (0.5265)和nDCG@3(0.6115),同时捆绑最佳回击@3(0.6744).
主动过滤可以去掉有用的候选人,并逐渐降低检索精度.

blocks.en:
Memory cost. Retrieval and generation run in separate stages without modifying the VACE DiT architecture.
The video-generation stage retains approximately the same peak memory requirement as VACE.
Image registration uses about 8 GB, while Qwen3.5-27B requires approximately 40 GB (distributed across two servers), compared with about 13 GB for Qwen3.5-9B during retrieval.
Thus, the smaller VLM reduces retrieval memory cost without changing the generator.
blocks.zh:
记忆成本。 检索和生成在不修改VACE DIT架构的情况下分出不同阶段运行.
视频生成阶段保留了大约与VACE相同的峰值内存要求.
图像注册使用约8GB,而Quen3.5-27B则需要约40GB(分布在两个服务器之间),而检索时的Quen3.5-9B则需要约13GB.
因此,较小的VLM在不改变生成器的情况下会降低取回内存的成本.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We introduce LongSCOP, a long video out-painting framework, built upon stable generation strategies, key reference frame retrieval method, large-scale training datasets, and a long video out-painting benchmark, showing clear improvement on both generation stability and semantic coherence.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LongSCOP,一个长视频出画框架,基于稳定的生成策略,关键参考框架检索方法,大规模培训数据集,以及长视频出画基准,显示在生成稳定性和语义一致性上都有明显改善.

blocks.en: Limitations Despite its effectiveness, LongSCOP still has some limitations. The VLM-based retrieval module introduces additional inference cost, and its benefit depends on the availability of informative reference frames in the input video. Performance may degrade when missing regions never appear in other frames. How to reduce the retrieval time and how to enhance the robustness of the reference frame remain important directions for future work. In addition, it is important to improve the speed of self-forcing training, which is also left as our future works.
blocks.zh: LongSCOP尽管有效,但仍有一些局限性。 基于VLM的检索模块引入了额外的推论成本,其好处取决于输入视频中是否有信息参考框架. 当缺失区域从未出现在其他框架时,性能可能会下降。 如何减少检索时间以及如何加强参考框架的稳健性仍然是今后工作的重要方向。 此外,必须提高自强训练的速度,这也作为我们未来的活活.
